reasoning: The icon combines a video player frame (play triangle) with a linked frame (chain link), clearly signifying a video link, media URL, or embedded video. It fits tasks centered on sharing, fixing, or embedding video links, though it is narrower than a general video or link icon and could resemble dual monitors at tiny sizes.
